_about: Criteria drafted by reading each scheme's official eligibility text on myScheme (quoted in 'evidence'). Status stays 'auto' until a person checks them against the guideline PDF and imports the checklist (python -m ingest.verify import). 'not_expressible' lists rules the frozen criteria JSON cannot hold; the rule engine cannot check those, so answers must mention them.

pm-kisan.evidence: All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable land holding in their names are eligible.
not_expressible: exclusions: institutional landholders, income-tax payers, government employees, pensioners >= Rs 10,000/month

kcc.evidence: Farmers - individual/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators; tenant farmers, oral lessees & share croppers; SHGs/JLGs of farmers.

pmfby.evidence: All farmers, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers growing notified crops in notified areas.
not_expressible: notified crops in notified areas only
apply within the sowing-season window

apy.evidence: The minimum age of joining APY is 18 years and maximum is 40 years.
not_expressible: not for current or past income-tax payers (from 1 Oct 2022)
needs a savings bank account

pmjjby.evidence: The age of the applicant must be between 18 to 50 Years. The applicant must hold an individual bank / post office account.

pmsby.evidence: Individual bank account holders of participating banks aged between 18 years (completed) and 70 years.

pmuy.evidence: An adult woman belonging to a poor household and not having an LPG connection in her household. Male member from a household cannot apply.
not_expressible: 'poor household' also covers SECC 2011, SC/ST, PMAY, AAY and other listed categories, not only BPL card holders
no existing LPG connection in the household

ignwps.evidence: The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-79 years ... household living below the poverty line.
not_expressible: must be a widow (marital status is not a profile field)

igndps.evidence: The age of the applicant should be 18 years and above ... disability should be more than 80% ... should belong to the Below Poverty Line. (National Social Assistance Programme sets the upper limit at 79.)
not_expressible: disability must be above 80%

pmegp.evidence: Any individual, above 18 years of age. There will be no income ceiling.
not_expressible: VIII pass for projects above Rs 10 lakh (manufacturing) / Rs 5 lakh (service)
new projects only

pmmy.evidence: Eligible borrowers: individuals, proprietary concerns, partnership firms, companies ... for non-farm income-generating micro enterprises.
not_expressible: must not be a loan defaulter

pm-svanidhi.evidence: Street vendors in possession of Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies, or with a Letter of Recommendation.

sui.evidence: Finance is provided for Greenfield Enterprises. If the applicant is a male, he must be from SC / ST category. The age of the applicant must be at least 18 years.
not_expressible: men must be SC/ST (an either-or rule: women of any category, or SC/ST men)
greenfield enterprises only

mgnrega.evidence: The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. The applicant must be residing in a Rural Area.
not_expressible: rural residence

pmmvy.evidence: The applicant should be of at least 19 years old and a pregnant women ... only for the first live birth.
not_expressible: pregnant or lactating
first live birth (second if a girl child)

ksy.evidence: The beneficiary's family should be a resident of Uttar Pradesh ... maximum annual family income ... ₹3,00,000.
not_expressible: for girl children; at most two children in the family

pmay-u.evidence: EWS up to ₹3,00,000 ... MIG-2 between ₹12,00,001 and ₹18,00,000. Must not own a pucca house anywhere in the country.
not_expressible: no pucca house owned by the family
town must be covered under the scheme

pmjdy.evidence: The applicant should be an Indian National. If minors above ten years apply, they will require support from their legal guardians.
